Read `AGENTS.md` in the repo root first (project context, rules, data facts, API contract, known traps).
Then read the role file in `docs/roles/` matching the person you are helping (A-data, B-image-science, C-frontend, D-product-deploy), and work through its tasks in order.
Never present synthetic data as real, never claim untested code works, and only edit files owned by that person's role.
